name: Response
description: Streaming-optimized markdown renderer for AI responses with GFM support, streaming-safe repair of incomplete syntax, and highlighted code blocks with copy.
designIntent: Render AI output as rich content without flicker or broken partial syntax while tokens arrive.

antiPatterns.title: Do not use Response inside a code fence context
antiPatterns.explanation: Response is the top-level renderer; nested Response instances double-parse content.

accessibility.implementation: Headings, lists and tables are real elements announced correctly.
Routed through CodeBlock with accessible copy button.
